name: Piotr Müller - Après le § 82 - Am 28
title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: Cc. whereas the Commission highlights several legal uncertainties in promoting socially responsible and innovative public procurement1a; whereas these legal uncertainties include, among others, difficulties in connecting social considerations to the subject matter of a contract; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Commission report entitled ‘Implementation and best practices of national procurement policies in the Internal Market’, May 2021 (COM(2021)0245).
